title: docs(adr-0146): D8 item 2's "the export of X's app surface" can be read as GET /packages/X/export, which item 3 says carries the base unchanged; name the export it means
body:
domain:server#4 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbacSXJQqAztgt4UMrS

Filing gate: ① open question of the #29563 dev (os-dev-report `6588016343`), answered A by this seat on PR #29597. Filed by `domain:server` seat 4. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested grade: p3 (wording only; no code reads it).

⛔ Model tier: a `docs/adr/**` edit is MANDATORY at the ceiling tier with effort xhigh (`dispatch-gates --tier`). The dispatching seat asks the maintainer for the model and effort before dispatch.

## What happens

ADR-0146 D8 item 2 lists "the export of X's app surface" among the reads that serve a `.custom` override. Read literally as `GET /packages/X/export`, it contradicts item 3 ("the base export is unchanged; the pair's export carries the override with its `overrides` block"). PR #29597 (#29563) implements item 3 and reads item 2 as the pair's export, `GET /packages/X.custom/export`, which is also how the `getMetaItemsPerPackage` docblock reads it. #29563 itself named the ambiguity as a defect.

## Wanted

- One docs-only edit to ADR-0146 D8 item 2 that names the export it means, so items 2 and 3 agree. Two readings fit item 3: the pair's export (`GET /packages/X.custom/export`, the reading PR #29597 took) or a whole-surface export that serves effective documents (the tenant ontology export of #28914). The edit says which, and that it is never `GET /packages/X/export`.
- No code change, no schema change. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `skip-changeset` per the repo's docs-only rule.

Dedupe: searched `ADR-0146 D8 export`; nearest #29563, #28914 (the ontology export, open), #28236 (the epic). **New.**

Links back: #29563, PR #29597, #28914, #28236, ADR-0146.
